C1791.title: Cybercriminals Exploit Remote Monitoring Tools to Infiltrate Logistics and Freight Networks
C1791.summary: According to The Hacker News, since at least June 2025 cybercriminals have used remote monitoring and management tools to infiltrate logistics and freight company networks with the goal of stealing physical cargo, especially food and beverage products. Attackers abused legitimate remote access software to bypass security controls and enter enterprise systems. Claims about data theft or ransomware deployment should be supported by corresponding sources.
